notes: Windows C engine (MSVC) and Linux C engine (gcc 13) agree token-for-token on all three prompts — cross-platform, cross-compiler portability of the C core proven

engine/main.c needed a forward declaration of run_gen for gcc -std=c23 (MSVC only warned); bus.c is Windows-only, Linux build uses a 3-function stub
tokenizer: llama3_tok.py (pure stdlib) encodes all three prompts; decode verified round-trip
truth generation on laptop: 1.11-1.72 tok/s per prompt, 256 tokens each
